listening.imageAlt: Một khu chợ ngoài trời, người đàn ông xách túi đứng giữa lối đi ướt, hai bên là các sạp hàng

audio.text: Vendors are setting up umbrellas.
Goods are being loaded onto a boat.
Some people are standing in an outdoor market.
Some shoppers are paying at a register.

options: Vendors are setting up umbrellas.
Goods are being loaded onto a boat.
Some people are standing in an outdoor market.
Some shoppers are paying at a register.

why.vi: Cảnh là chợ ngoài trời có người đứng: are standing in an outdoor market. Không thấy quầy tính tiền hay thuyền.
why.en: The scene is an open-air market with people standing, so (C) is right. There is no register or boat.

questions.trap: Câu (D) nghe hợp với việc mua sắm, nhưng ảnh không có quầy tính tiền.

listening.imageAlt: Nhiều con sứa xanh trong bể chồng lên nhau, một con lớn ở giữa bên phải

audio.text: Some jellyfish have been removed from a tank.
Some jellyfish are overlapping one another.
A sheet is being placed over the tank.
A jellyfish is resting on the floor.

options: Some jellyfish have been removed from a tank.
Some jellyfish are overlapping one another.
A sheet is being placed over the tank.
A jellyfish is resting on the floor.

why.vi: Các con sứa nằm chồng lên nhau: are overlapping. Không có ai lấy sứa ra khỏi bể.
why.en: The jellyfish overlap, so (B) is correct. None have been taken out.

questions.trap: Câu (A) dùng thì hoàn thành bị động rất giống câu mô tả vị trí, nên nghe khá thuyết phục, nhưng không có sứa nào bị lấy ra.

listening.imageAlt: Một con sứa lớn trong suốt bơi ngang sang trái, xung quanh có vài con nhỏ

audio.text: A fish is swallowing a jellyfish.
A large jellyfish is swimming toward the left.
A jellyfish is stuck in a net.
Some jellyfish are being separated into containers.

options: A fish is swallowing a jellyfish.
A large jellyfish is swimming toward the left.
A jellyfish is stuck in a net.
Some jellyfish are being separated into containers.

why.vi: Con sứa lớn đang bơi về phía bên trái ảnh: swimming toward the left. Không có lưới hay hộp đựng.
why.en: The big jellyfish moves toward the left side, so (B) fits. No net or containers appear.

questions.trap: Câu (D) là bị động về công việc của nhân viên, nhưng không có ai trong ảnh.

listening.imageAlt: Nhiều con sứa có xúc tu cam đang trôi trong bể, cái nắp chuông quay xuống

audio.text: Some jellyfish are resting on the bottom of a tank.
A jellyfish is being lifted out of the water.
Some jellyfish have been placed in buckets.
Several jellyfish with orange arms are floating in the water.

options: Some jellyfish are resting on the bottom of a tank.
A jellyfish is being lifted out of the water.
Some jellyfish have been placed in buckets.
Several jellyfish with orange arms are floating in the water.

why.vi: Sứa có phần tay màu cam đang trôi trong nước nên (D) đúng. Không có con nào ở đáy bể hay trong xô.
why.en: Jellyfish with orange arms float in the water, so (D) is correct. None rest on the bottom or sit in buckets.

questions.trap: Câu (C) dùng 'have been placed' nghe giống mô tả vị trí đồ vật, nhưng không có xô nào trong ảnh.

audio.text: How much is the bus fare?
Two dollars each way.
It's a fine day.
Fair enough.

options: Two dollars each way.
It's a fine day.
Fair enough.

why.vi: Fare là tiền vé; 'Two dollars each way' là giá. Fare, fine, fair nghe gần giống nhau.
why.en: 'Fare' means the ticket price, so 'Two dollars each way' answers. Fare, fine and fair sound alike.

questions.trap: (B) và (C) chỉ nghe giống fare nhưng không nói giá vé.

audio.text: Is there a fee to enter the aquarium?
Yes, ten dollars for adults.
It's a fine aquarium.
Fish and chips.

options: Yes, ten dollars for adults.
It's a fine aquarium.
Fish and chips.

why.vi: Fee là phí vào cửa; 'ten dollars for adults' xác nhận có phí.
why.en: 'Fee' means an entry charge, and 'ten dollars for adults' confirms it.

questions.trap: (B) nghe giống fee/fine nhưng chỉ khen ngợi.

audio.text: Should we leave a tip for the driver?
He has a tipped hat.
It's already included in the fare.
Yes, he drives fast.

options: He has a tipped hat.
It's already included in the fare.
Yes, he drives fast.

why.vi: Tip là tiền boa; 'included in the fare' nghĩa là không cần thêm.
why.en: 'Tip' is a gratuity, and 'included in the fare' means no extra is needed.

audio.text: Why was he fined at the airport?
The airport is fine.
He brought in some fruit without declaring it.
Yes, at the finish.

options: The airport is fine.
He brought in some fruit without declaring it.
Yes, at the finish.

why.vi: Fined là bị phạt; 'brought in fruit without declaring it' là lý do.
why.en: 'Fined' means penalized, and bringing in undeclared fruit is the reason.

questions.trap: (A) nghe giống fine nhưng không giải thích gì.

audio.text: When can the tank be refilled?
It's a full tank.
As soon as the water test is clear.
In the filter room.

options: It's a full tank.
As soon as the water test is clear.
In the filter room.

why.vi: When hỏi lúc nào; điều kiện 'as soon as the water test is clear' trả lời.
why.en: 'When' asks about timing, and 'as soon as the water test is clear' answers it.

questions.trap: (A) lặp tank nhưng nói về trạng thái.

audio.text: Whom should I contact about the booking?
The book is on the table.
Yes, I'm booking it.
Ms. Pham in the events office.

options: The book is on the table.
Yes, I'm booking it.
Ms. Pham in the events office.

why.vi: Whom hỏi người nhận; 'Ms. Pham' là người cần liên hệ.
why.en: 'Whom' asks about the person to contact, and Ms. Pham is one.

questions.trap: (A) lặp book/booking nhưng là quyển sách.

audio.text: I wish we could have started the tour earlier.
The guide said the gates open at nine.
He wished us a pleasant trip.
Early tours were not available.

options: The guide said the gates open at nine.
He wished us a pleasant trip.
Early tours were not available.

why.vi: Wish + could have + V3 diễn tả tiếc nuối; 'gates open at nine' giải thích vì sao không thể.
why.en: 'Wish we could have' expresses regret, and the gate time explains why not.

questions.trap: (B) lặp wish nhưng chuyển sang chủ đề khác.

audio.text: Aren't you supposed to be working the split shift today?
It's a long split.
I'm splitting a sandwich with her.
I swapped with Ms. Lan last week.

options: It's a long split.
I'm splitting a sandwich with her.
I swapped with Ms. Lan last week.

why.vi: Câu hỏi phủ định; 'I swapped with Ms. Lan' giải thích không phải ca của mình.
why.en: In reply to the negative question, 'I swapped' explains it is not her shift.
